list_search_services.title: List search services in the subscription
list_search_services.description: List every Azure AI Search service in the subscription, across all resource groups, with each one's SKU, replica and partition counts, location and provisioning state. The starting point for finding a service whose resource group you do not already know.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Every search service in the subscription.

items.description: id, name, location, sku, tags and properties (replicaCount, partitionCount, status, hostingMode).

list_search_services_by_resource_group.title: List search services in a resource group
list_search_services_by_resource_group.description: List the Azure AI Search services in one resource group, with their SKUs, scale and provisioning state. Narrower and cheaper than scanning the whole subscription when the group is known.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The search services in the resource group.

items.description: id, name, location, sku and properties.

get_search_service.title: Get a search service
get_search_service.description: Read one search service's full ARM resource -- SKU, replica and partition counts, hosting mode, public network access, network rules, authentication options, managed identity and provisioning state. Poll this after a scale change to see provisioningState reach "succeeded".

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The search service resource.

properties.description: replicaCount, partitionCount, status, statusDetails, provisioningState, hostingMode, publicNetworkAccess, networkRuleSet, authOptions.

create_or_update_search_service.title: Create or replace a search service
create_or_update_search_service.description: Create a search service, or replace an existing one's definition. This is a full PUT -- properties you leave out are reset, so prefer update_search_service for changing scale or tags on a live service. The SKU cannot be changed after creation; free tier allows one replica and one partition only. Returns while provisioning continues, so poll get_search_service.

resource_group.description: Resource group to create the service in.

service_name.description: Name of the service -- becomes the first label of its endpoint, so it must be globally unique.

location.description: Azure region for the service, e.g. westeurope.

sku.description: Pricing tier. Cannot be changed after the service is created.

replica_count.description: Replicas, which set query throughput and availability. 1 to 12.

partition_count.description: Partitions, which set storage and indexing throughput. 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12.

hosting_mode.description: highDensity packs many small indexes onto standard3; default otherwise.

public_network_access.description: Whether the service answers on its public endpoint at all.

disable_local_auth.description: Turn API keys off entirely, leaving Entra ID as the only data-plane auth.

semantic_search.description: Semantic ranker tier for the service.

identity.description: Managed identity for the service, e.g. {"type": "SystemAssigned"}.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service resource as stored, with provisioning still in progress.

update_search_service.title: Update a search service
update_search_service.description: Merge changes into an existing search service -- scale replicas or partitions, retag, change public network access or firewall rules. Unlike the PUT form this leaves untouched properties alone, which makes it the right tool for a live service. Scaling is asynchronous; watch provisioningState with get_search_service.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

service_name.description: Name of the service to update.

replica_count.description: New replica count, for query throughput and availability.

partition_count.description: New partition count, for storage and indexing throughput.

sku.description: Pricing tier. Only settable on services that were created without one.

public_network_access.description: Whether the service answers on its public endpoint.

network_rule_set.description: Replacement IP firewall rules for the service.

auth_options.description: How data-plane calls authenticate -- keys, Entra ID, or both.

disable_local_auth.description: Turn API keys off, leaving Entra ID as the only data-plane auth.

semantic_search.description: Semantic ranker tier for the service.

tags.description: Replacement resource tags as key/value pairs.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service resource after the merge.

delete_search_service.title: Delete a search service
delete_search_service.description: Delete a search service and everything in it -- every index, indexer, data source, skillset and document. There is no recycle bin and no restore, so confirm the service name against get_search_service before calling this.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

service_name.description: Name of the service to delete.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Empty -- 200 when deleted, 204 when the service was already gone.

list_admin_keys.title: Get a service's admin API keys
list_admin_keys.description: Return the service's two admin keys, which grant full read and write access to every index and document on it. These are the credentials the azure-ai-search data-plane connector takes. Treat the response as a secret: it is the whole service.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service's two admin keys.

regenerate_admin_key.title: Regenerate an admin API key
regenerate_admin_key.description: Roll one of the two admin keys. Anything still using the old value stops working immediately, which is why there are two: move clients to the secondary, roll the primary, move them back, roll the secondary.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

key_kind.description: Which of the two admin keys to roll.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Both admin keys, with the rolled one holding its new value.

list_query_keys.title: List a service's query keys
list_query_keys.description: List the read-only query keys defined on the service, each with its name and value. A query key can search documents but cannot see or change index definitions, which makes it the key to ship in a client application.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service's query keys.

create_query_key.title: Create a query key
create_query_key.description: Mint a new read-only query key with a name of your choosing. Give each client application its own named key so one can be revoked with delete_query_key without disturbing the others. Up to 50 per service.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

key_name.description: A label for the key, so it can be recognised and revoked later.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The new query key and its name.

delete_query_key.title: Delete a query key
delete_query_key.description: Revoke a query key by its value, not its name -- take the value from list_query_keys. Every client still sending that key starts getting 403 immediately.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

key.description: The key's value, from list_query_keys -- not its name.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Empty -- 204 when revoked, 404 when no such key exists.

check_name_availability.title: Check whether a service name is free
check_name_availability.description: Ask whether a proposed service name can be used. Service names are globally unique because they become the DNS label of the endpoint, so check before create_or_update_search_service rather than after it fails.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Whether the name is free, and why not when it is taken.

list_usages.title: List search quota usage in a region
list_usages.description: Report, per SKU, how many search services the subscription already has in a region against how many it may have. Check this before creating a service, since hitting the quota is the usual cause of a create failing.

location.description: Azure region to report quota for, e.g. westeurope.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Per-SKU current usage and limit in the region.

items.description: unit, currentValue, limit and name (value and localizedValue).

list_private_endpoint_connections.title: List private endpoint connections
list_private_endpoint_connections.description: List the private endpoint connections to a search service, each with the state of its approval. This is how a service is reached from a virtual network without a public endpoint.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service's private endpoint connections.

get_private_endpoint_connection.title: Get a private endpoint connection
get_private_endpoint_connection.description: Read one private endpoint connection, including the approval state and any description the approver left. Use it to confirm a pending request before approving it.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

connection_name.description: Name of the private endpoint connection.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The private endpoint connection and its approval state.

update_private_endpoint_connection.title: Approve or reject a private endpoint connection
update_private_endpoint_connection.description: Set the approval state of a private endpoint connection -- Approved lets the private endpoint reach the service, Rejected refuses it. This is the call that completes a cross-subscription private link request.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

connection_name.description: Name of the private endpoint connection.

status.description: New approval state for the connection.

description.description: Note recorded with the decision, shown to the requester.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The connection after the state change.

delete_private_endpoint_connection.title: Delete a private endpoint connection
delete_private_endpoint_connection.description: Remove a private endpoint connection. Traffic from that private endpoint stops reaching the service at once; if the service also has public access disabled, it may become unreachable entirely.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

connection_name.description: Name of the private endpoint connection to remove.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The connection as it was deleted, or empty when already gone.

list_supported_private_link_resources.title: List private link resource types
list_supported_private_link_resources.description: List the group ids a private endpoint may target on a search service. Needed when creating the private endpoint itself, which asks for the group id rather than inferring it.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The private link group ids the service supports.

items.description: id, name and properties (groupId, requiredMembers, requiredZoneNames).

list_shared_private_link_resources.title: List shared private link resources
list_shared_private_link_resources.description: List the outbound private links a search service holds -- the connections an indexer uses to reach a storage account, SQL database or Cosmos DB that has no public endpoint.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The service's outbound shared private link resources.

items.description: id, name and properties (privateLinkResourceId, groupId, status, provisioningState).

get_shared_private_link_resource.title: Get a shared private link resource
get_shared_private_link_resource.description: Read one outbound private link and its status. status is Pending until the owner of the target resource approves the request, and an indexer cannot use the link before then.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

link_name.description: Name of the shared private link resource.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The shared private link resource and its approval status.

create_shared_private_link_resource.title: Create an outbound private link
create_shared_private_link_resource.description: Ask a search service for a private outbound connection to another Azure resource, so its indexers can reach a data source that has no public endpoint. The target's owner must approve the request before the link works -- poll get_shared_private_link_resource until status is Approved.

resource_group.description: Resource group the search service is in.

link_name.description: A name for the link, used to read and delete it later.

private_link_resource_id.description: Full ARM resource id of the target -- the storage account, SQL server or Cosmos DB account.

group_id.description: Sub-resource to connect to, e.g. blob, sqlServer, table, Sql for Cosmos DB.

request_message.description: Message shown to the target resource's owner when they review the request.

resource_region.description: Region of the target resource, required when it differs from the service's.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The link as created, with status Pending until it is approved.

delete_shared_private_link_resource.title: Delete an outbound private link
delete_shared_private_link_resource.description: Remove a shared private link. Any indexer relying on it to reach its data source starts failing on its next run, so repoint or disable those first.

resource_group.description: Resource group the service is in.

link_name.description: Name of the shared private link resource to delete.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: Empty; deletion is asynchronous and reports through the azure-asyncoperation header.

list_operations.title: List Microsoft.Search operations
list_operations.description: List every ARM operation the Microsoft.Search provider exposes, with the display name and description of each. Useful for working out which role action a permission error is actually complaining about.

api_version.description: Microsoft.Search ARM API version to call.

output.description: The provider's available operations.

items.description: name and display (provider, resource, operation, description).
